title: Serve FlowWeb a facts sheet (beta end, launch day, plan prices, launcher minutes) so its drafts quote only what the site shows

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-11 "Build this all out" (FlowWeb re-engagement email batch): FlowWeb's fwd already GETs /api/webhooks/flowweb-facts daily (FW-C-102) and got 404, so its facts check fell back to dates typed in its config.

detail: GET /api/webhooks/flowweb-facts, signed with FLOWWEB_OUTCOMES_SECRET over an empty body (flowweb-claim scheme), answers {as_of, beta_ends, launch_on, prices, launcher_minutes}. beta_ends and launch_on read lib/core/launch-dates.ts; prices read getPricingValues() (catalog plus /admin/pricing rows) as <plan>_monthly/_annual/_list dollars; launcher_minutes reads CLOCK_BUDGET_MS. No take-rates or other settings. Unsigned answers 401 before any read; a failed pricing read answers 500 so FlowWeb keeps its last good sheet. Runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md "FlowWeb facts sheet".
